items.caption: 再 in a small-seal-script style, shown in a modern vector redraw. Its graphic origin remains disputed.
items.alt: A black small-seal-script-style form of 再 on a white background, with a long top stroke and stacked horizontal and vertical strokes below.
items.selection_reason: This is a clear example of 再 in a later script style, useful for seeing a documented form without treating it as an ancient artifact or proof of the graph’s origin.

limitations.text: This modern redraw is not an ancient inscription or dated artifact image. The graph’s original construction and the relationship of its parts remain unresolved among competing explanations.
